questions.question: If a number 'a' is divisible by 6 and 21, then 5a is divisible by :
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The number 'a' is divisible by 6 and 21

**Concept:**

If a number is divisible by two numbers, it is also divisible by their LCM

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 6 and 21 is 42

The new number '5a' will be divisible by 5 times the original factors.

⇒ 5 × LCM(6, 21) = 5 × 42 = 210.

**Hence, 5a is divisible by 210.**

questions.question: Find the largest value of k such that a 6-digit number 450k1k is divisible by 3.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

6 digit number 450k1k is divisible by 3.

**Concept:**

A given number is divisible by 3, if the sum of the digits of the given number is divisible by 3.

**Calculation:**

4 + 5 + 0 + k + 1 + k = 10 + 2k

So, possible values of k is 1, 4, 7. i.e. (10 + 2 × 1 = 12, 10 + 2 × 4 = 18 and 10 + 2 × 7 = 24)

Largest value of k is 7.

**∴ The largest value of k is 7.**

questions.question: The smallest number that can be added to 56789 to make it divisible by 345 is x. What is the sum of the digits of x?
questions.solution:
**Concept: **

Obtain the remainder by dividing the given number from the divisor

The remainder, so obtained, when subtracted from the divisor gives the required value.

**Calculation:**

⇒ 56789 = 56580 + 209 = 345 × 164 + 209

Remainder = 209

Now, 209 + x = 345

⇒ x = 345 – 209

⇒ x = 136

∴ Sum of the digits of 136 = (1 + 3 + 6) = 10

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** **Given:**

Number = 56789

Divisor = 345

**Formula Used:**

Smallest number to be added = Divisor - (Number % Divisor)

**Calculation:**

Remainder when 56789 is divided by 345:

⇒ 56789 % 345

⇒ 56789 - (56789 / 345) × 345

⇒ 56789 - 164 × 345

⇒ 56789 - 56580

⇒ 209

Smallest number to be added = 345 - 209

⇒ x = 136

Sum of the digits of x:

⇒ 1 + 3 + 6

⇒ 10

**The sum of the digits of x is 10.**

questions.question: What is the remainder, when 1421 × 1423 × 1425 is divided by 12 ?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

⇒ (1421 × 1423 × 1425)/12

1421 divided by 12 gives the remainder 5.

1423 divided by 12 gives the remainder 7.

1425 divided by 12 gives the remainder 9.

So, the remainder will be: 5 × 7 × 9 = 315

Now, when we divide 315 by 12, we get 3 as a remainder

Hence, the required remainder = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

questions.question: When f(x) = 15x³ – 14x² – 4x + 10 is divided by (3x + 2), then the remainder is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By the Remainder Theorem, if a polynomial f(x) is divided by (ax + b), the remainder is f(−b/a).

Here, dividing by (3x + 2) means we substitute x = −2/3 into f(x).

f(−2/3) = 15(−8/27) − 14(4/9) − 4(−2/3) + 10

f(−2/3) = −40/9 − 56/9 + 24/9 + 90/9 = 18/9 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Polynomial f(x) = 15x³ − 14x² − 4x + 10

Divisor = 3x + 2

**Formula Used:**

Remainder Theorem: If f(x) is divided by ax + b, the remainder is f(−b/a).

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let 3x + 2 = 0

⇒ 3x = −2

⇒ x = −2/3

⇒ Substitute x = −2/3 in f(x) to find the remainder:

⇒ Remainder = 15(−2/3)³ − 14(−2/3)² − 4(−2/3) + 10

⇒ Remainder = 15(−8/27) − 14(4/9) + 8/3 + 10

⇒ Remainder = −40/9 − 56/9 + 24/9 + 90/9

⇒ Remainder = (−40 − 56 + 24 + 90) / 9

⇒ Remainder = 18 / 9

⇒ Remainder = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Remainder Theorem

When a polynomial p(x) is divided by a linear polynomial (x − a), the remainder is equal to p(a).

Factor Theorem

A polynomial p(x) has a factor (x − a) if and only if p(a) = 0. This is a special case of the remainder theorem.

Polynomial Division

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder, where the degree of the Remainder is strictly less than the degree of the Divisor.

questions.question: If a number is divided by 136 the remainder gets 36, then if the number is divided by 17. What will be the remainder?
questions.solution:
Given,

1 Divisor = 136

2 Divisor = 17

1 Remainder = 36

Formula Used 

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

Calculation -

Let the given number divided by 136 gives the quotient K and remainder 36

⇒ The given number = (136K + 36)

⇒ (17 × 8K) + (17 × 2) + 2

⇒ 17(8K + 2) + 2

Hence the given number is divided by 17 and the remainder will get = 2

questions.question: The largest four-digit number which when divided by 7, 11 and 13 leaves remainder 4 in each case is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The largest four-digit number when divided by 7, 11, and 13

The remainder in each case is 4

Concept used:

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

Calculation:

Let the largest 4-digit number which when divided by 7, 11 and 13 leaves remainder 4 in each case is N.

LCM (7, 11, and 13) = 7 × 11 × 13 = 1001

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e89a02eaddf6f67c3aca2aab029f559342f24e635e53d8b6f4ad30cfbdca80a.png] 

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

Here, 9999 = 1001 × 9 + 990

⇒ 9999 - 990 = 1001 × 9

⇒ 9009 = 1001 × 9

So, 9009 is the largest 4-digit number which is a multiple of 1001.

Hence, N - 4 = 9009

⇒ N = 9013

Hence, The Required value is 9013.
